blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rebounded Monday as investors bought beaten-down shares, ending a five-session losing streak. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 2.03 percent, or 114.18 points, to close at 5,743.21. READ: PSEi slips for 5th straight day on economic woes Philstocks Financial Inc. attributed the recovery to bargain hunting and positive signals from Wall Street’s closing performance last week. The brokerage said a weaker-than-expected US jobs report tempered expectations of a hawkish Federal Reserve, helping lift sentiment in the local market.
